id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

isNewEntity.description:
Whether the type under edit is a new entity. This should only be set from `true` to `false` once
a new entity type is saved successfully. Should be set to false if editing an existing root package type
or remixing a type.

isRemix.description: Whether the type under edit is a remix type.

activeTypeName.description: The name of the type under edit.

codeEditorTemplates.description: The templates to be rendered when creating a new entity

typeDeclarationCode.description: The code that is rendered for the type declaration in the code editor.

initialTypeDeclarationCode.description: The type declaration code as it is first loaded in the code editor.

typeImplementationJsCode.description: The js implementation code for the type.

remixImplementationJsCode.description: If remixing, the remix implementation js code.

initialTypeImplementationJsCode.description: The initial js implementation code for the type, as it is first loaded in the code editor.

initialRemixImplementationJsCode.description: If remixing, the initial js implementation code for the remix, as it is first loaded in the code editor.

functionNamesList.description: A list of function names for the current type, grouped by member functions and static functions.

functionDeclarations.description: A map of function names to their declarations.

functionImplementationStatus.description: Status of if the function is implemented or not

resolvedDeclarationCode.description: Resolved remix code, stored separately so we don't clear the original code

visibleEditorPane.description: The editor pane that is currently visible

editorPaneMode.description: {@link DataFusionCodeEditorContainerMode} enum to describe the editor pane mode; read-only or edit

remixPaneMode.description: {@link DataFusionCodeEditorContainerMode} enum to describe the remix pane mode; edit or read-only

remixEditMode.description: When in remix `edit` mode, we can be in one of three views

didSetInitialRemixCode.description: Set the initial remix code once. Thereafter, use the code state

isEvaluatingSyntax.description: Whether the code editor is currently evaluating syntax.

isCreatingOrUpdatingEntity.description: Whether the code editor is currently saving or updating a type.

codeEditorConsoleIssues.description: The list of issues in the code editor console, grouped by file.

shouldFetchCodeEditorConsoleIssues.description: Whether the fetch for the issues in the code editor console should start

codeEditorConsoleIssuesFetchCount.description:
Keeps track of how many times the code editor console issues have been fetched.
It is used to limit the number of fetch attempts.

codeEditorCreateUpdateModalTexts.description: The texts to be displayed in the code editor create/update modal.

codeEditorSuggestedFileContent.description:
The map of language to corresponding suggested file content
js -> suggested js impl of file
c3typ -> suggested type declaration of file
Will support python and json in 8.10

codeEditorOriginalFileContent.description:
The map of language to correponding original file content
This is used when the user rejects the suggested changes
js -> original js impl of file
c3typ -> original type declaration of file
Will support python and json in 8.10

codeEditorDiffPatches.description:
The map of language to correponding diff patches
This is used to show the diff and highlight in the code editor
e.g.
[
 {codeBlock: "line1\n", status: null, lineNumbers: [1]},
 {codeBlock: "line2\n", status: 'removed', lineNumbers: [2]},
 {codeBlock: "line2_modified\n", status: 'added', lineNumbers: [3]},
 {codeBlock: "line3\n", status: null, lineNumbers: [4]}
]

pendingResolutionMessageIds.description: The map of language to the id of latest message that contains suggested file content neither accepted nor rejected
